text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I opened a PR for the dashboard migration that includes a new KB section for kv-prefix SLO guidance and an example SDK snippet. Needs link audit + parity check with the Node/Rust snippets. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :eyes:

aj: Thanks — can you paste the SDK snippet here? I can run it in the smoke harness.

maria: Sure, extracted from the PR (minimal):

```js
// set kv prefix when creating a trace to scope SLO metrics
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
client.traces.create({
  name: 'api-request',
  kvPrefix: 'customer-123/',
  tags: { route: '/v1/complete' }
});
```

maria: The idea is to show how prefixing helps map dashboard KPIs to customer partitions.

devin: Quick note: the Rust snippet in the PR uses `kv_prefix` but the SDK expects `kvPrefix` in the latest release. We should either normalize or add a tiny compatibility note.

samir: I ran the smoke harness with aj's consent earlier — Node snippet works but the prefix trimming behavior is different when `kvPrefix` ends with a `/`. Tests show double-slash in some metric keys. Recommend showing normalized helper: `normalizePrefix(p)`.

helen: Also found 2 broken links in the migration doc block: one points to `/tracing/hooks/v1` which we deleted last quarter. Should point to `/observability/tracing-hooks` instead.

maria: Good catch. I've flagged the two links in the PR description but can push a tiny commit.

aj: If you push the commit I can re-run the docs CI. Also, can we add a one-line example for the fallback behavior when prefix is missing? Common gotcha.

maria: Adding this quick fallback snippet then: ```js
const prefix = normalizePrefix(cfg.kvPrefix || 'default/');
```

devin: +1. Can you include a single-line explanation under the code block: "Use normalized prefixes to avoid double-slash metric keys and ensure SLO grouping."

maria: Will do.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs lint failed on the PR due to an absolute link to internal-runbook.md — replace with relative path `/docs/runbooks/internal-runbook.md`.

samir: I can take the link sweep if you want. I'll run a quick grep for `/tracing/hooks/v1` and `internal-runbook.md` across the repo and prepare a commit.

helen: Please also add a short test in the examples folder that asserts `normalizePrefix('abc') === 'abc/'` and `normalizePrefix('abc/') === 'abc/'` so we don't regress. Tiny JS test.

aj: Test + CI green -> we can merge. Is there any customer-impacting behavior? Ops?

maria: No customer impact; purely docs + examples + a small normalization helper for snippet clarity.

deploy-bot: Staging docs site build queued (job #9785).

samir: I'll push the fixes in a single commit: link fixes, normalize helper, test, and update Rust snippet to use `kvPrefix` var name. ETA 30m.

maria: Amazing — assigning review to aj + helen when ready. Thanks! :tada:
